info.name: Fetch a Full Documentation Version Including Diff Summary

params.name: version_id
params.description: UUID of an existing version from which to fetch a documentation change

params.name: formats
params.description:
A list of formats to render in the response. Possible
values are `text`, `markdown`, `html` or `json`. If not
provided defaults to render both `text`, `markdown` and
`json` formats.
